marco: FYI I opened a PR to tidy up the Orion-XL model card: clarify supported variants, add sample prompt/response for chain-of-thought, and fix a dead link to the runtime matrix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/903

anya: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) include a one-line migration note for teams moving from orion-xl-fp16 to orion-xl-quant (expect subtle rank changes), and 2) update the SDK snippet to async streaming.

marco: Added migration blurb: "When migrating from fp16 -> quant, run a small evaluation set to detect ordering changes; use reranking if necessary." Also swapped the snippet to AsyncClient.stream_generate.

sam: Can you paste the streaming snippet you used? I want to run it in the examples test harness.

marco: Sure: ```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(model="orion-xl-quant", input="Explain x in simple terms"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

anya: Looks good. QA note: the benchmarks CSV header was missing the warmup field which causes our bench parser to mis-label the first sample. Please add warmup=200 to the header and re-upload.

marco: Done, re-uploaded CSV and added a footnote explaining test harness config. Fixed the runtime matrix link that was 404.

docs-bot: Running docs lint and example tests for PR #903.

qa-bot: Example test found the async snippet but flagged a missing await in the harness runner. Suggest adding an example wrapper: ```python
import asyncio
async def main():
    # the streaming code here
asyncio.run(main())
```

sam: Good catch. I pushed a small edit with the run wrapper.

anya: LGTM pending CI. Thanks for addressing the CSV and link.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #903 — merging now.

marco: merged. I'll open a follow-up to add a checklist item to the model-card template: include migration note + streaming example for large models.

sam: nice work, thanks!
